_provenance.source: Omarchy 4.0.2-1 VM (OMARCHY-VM.md): hyprctl getoption, ~/.config/foot/foot.ini, ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml, fc-match monospace, ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/shell.toml (generated; verbatim copy in shell.example.toml)
_provenance.note: Everything below was read from the running system, not from documentation. shell.toml is Omarchy's own settings-to-surface derivation layer; the alphas and scales here are its theme-independent constants (colors are substituted per theme from colors.toml).

hyprland.active_border: colors.accent (themes may override via hyprland_active_border / active_border_color in colors.toml: hackerman, last-horizon, lumon, solitude)
hyprland.inactive_border: rgba(595959aa) — fixed across themes unless the theme overrides

font.mono_family_source: fc-match monospace (fontconfig is the source of truth; omarchy-font-set changes it)

focus.note: mirrors hover by design: hover, keyboard cursor and tab focus read as one state

popup_menu_notification.border: accent (popups, notifications) or foreground (menu, tooltip, launcher)
